name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1-2 frame press and wave release input buffer.

hotkey.name: Stage Hotkey
hotkey.description: Key that cycles the buffer stage while playing (a letter, or Insert/Delete/Home/End/Page Up/Page Down). Shows an on-screen notice.

panel-hotkey.name: Panel Hotkey
panel-hotkey.description: Key that pauses the level and opens the Buffer settings panel while playing.

start-stage.name: Starting Stage
start-stage.description: Stage used when the game starts (1: 2/2, 2: 4/4, 3: 8/8, 4: 16/8, 5: CUSTOM, 6: OFF).

custom-normal-ticks.name: Custom Stage: Max Delay (all modes)
custom-normal-ticks.description: Maximum ticks an input may be delayed outside Wave. 4 ticks = 1 frame @ 60fps. Higher = more assist, but more delay risk.

custom-wave-ticks.name: Custom Stage: Max Delay (Wave)
custom-wave-ticks.description: Maximum ticks an input may be delayed in Wave.

normal-horizon.name: Lookahead (all modes, ticks)
normal-horizon.description: How far ahead the simulation checks for hazards. Higher sees more but costs more CPU.

wave-horizon.name: Lookahead (Wave, ticks)
wave-horizon.description: How far ahead the simulation checks in Wave (Mini Wave uses 50/65 of this).

spam-interval.name: Wave Spam Interval (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Inputs closer together than this count as wave spam.

spam-streak.name: Wave Spam Streak
spam-streak.description: How many rapid inputs in a row bypass the buffer in Wave.

ship-ticks.name: Ship Delay (ticks, 0 = off)
ship-ticks.description: Maximum ticks an input may be delayed in Ship. 0 leaves Ship completely untouched. Applies to both Ship and Dual-with-Ship.

rescue-ticks.name: Rescue Mode (lookahead ticks, 0 = off)
rescue-ticks.description: EXPERIMENTAL. When a death is predicted within this many ticks, the mod injects its own press/release if that avoids it. 0 = off. Try 24 to start. High values cost a lot of CPU; a real click gives control back to you.

rescue-margin.name: Rescue Margin (lower = more aggressive)
rescue-margin.description: Extra survival ticks an alternative input must give before Rescue acts (unless it clears the whole lookahead). 0 = acts on any improvement; higher = fewer clicks. Default 4.

rescue-urgency.name: Rescue Urgency (ticks)
rescue-urgency.description: Rescue only steps in when a death is predicted within this many ticks. Lower = you play more, rescue acts only at the last moment. Higher = it steps in earlier. 4 ticks = 1 frame @ 60fps. Default 8.

rescue-cooldown.name: Rescue Cooldown (ticks)
rescue-cooldown.description: Minimum ticks between two rescue actions. Higher = fewer extra clicks. 4 ticks = 1 frame @ 60fps.

exact-wait.name: Exact Click Wait (ticks, 0 = off)
exact-wait.description: Your click is held back for up to this many ticks and fired at the exact moment the simulation says it is safe. 0 = off. 4 ticks = 1 frame @ 60fps. Try 24. Long waits make the click late in Wave, so raise it carefully.

auto-zones.name: Auto Zones (0 = off, 1 = on)
auto-zones.description: Assist stays soft everywhere except near places where you died before on that level; there it uses your full configuration (Stage, Ship delay, Rescue). Needs a few attempts to learn.

auto-radius.name: Auto Radius (blocks)
auto-radius.description: Distance around each learned death where full assist is active.

auto-min-deaths.name: Auto Deaths To Trigger
auto-min-deaths.description: How many deaths close together mark a zone as a problem spot.
